```{r Finding functional maturity}
#creating a function to calculate fm values based on adult TC for each half by correlation 
calc_fm <- function(child_df, adult_df, roi_col) {
  fm_values <- child_df |>
    group_by(Sub) |>
    nest() |>
    mutate(
      fm_raw = map_dbl(data, function(df) {
        child_first <- df |> filter(time %in% first_half) |> pull({{ roi_col }})
        child_second <- df |> filter(time %in% second_half) |> pull({{ roi_col }})
        adult_first <- adult_df |> filter(time %in% first_half) |> pull({{ roi_col }})
        adult_second <- adult_df |> filter(time %in% second_half) |> pull({{ roi_col }})
        
        r1 <- cor(child_first, adult_first, use = "complete.obs")
        r2 <- cor(child_second, adult_second, use = "complete.obs")
        
        mean(c(r1,r2), na.rm = TRUE)  # calculating mean first
      })
    ) |>
    select(Sub, fm_raw) |>
  ungroup()

#manual z-scoring 
   mean_r12 <- mean(fm_values$fm_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
  sd_r12 <- sd(fm_values$fm_raw, na.rm = TRUE) 
   fm_final <- fm_values |>
  mutate(fm_z = (fm_raw - mean_r12)/sd_r12) |>
  select(Sub, fm_z) 
  
 return(fm_final)
}

# Apply FM function to rFFA and lFFA
fm_rFFA <- calc_fm(child_TC, adult_TC, roi_col = rFFA) |> rename(Fm_rFFA = fm_z)
fm_lFFA <- calc_fm(child_TC, adult_TC, roi_col = lFFA) |> rename(Fm_lFFA = fm_z)
```

```{r Finding functional connectivity}
#Creating a fucntion to calculate functional connectivity 
calc_fx <- function(child_df, roi1, roi2, fc_name) {
  fx_values <- child_df |>
    group_by(Sub) |>
    nest() |>
    mutate(
      fx_raw = map_dbl(data, function(df) {
        seg1 <- df |> filter(time %in% first_half)
        seg2 <- df |> filter(time %in% second_half)
        
        r3 <- cor(seg1[[roi1]], seg1[[roi2]], use = "complete.obs")
        r4 <- cor(seg2[[roi1]], seg2[[roi2]], use = "complete.obs")
        
        mean(c(r3, r4), na.rm = TRUE) #mean
      }),
    ) |>
    select(Sub, fx_raw) |>
    ungroup ()
   
    #Manual z-scoring 
    mean_r34 <- mean(fx_values$fx_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
    sd_r34 <- sd(fx_values$fx_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
  
    fx_final <- fx_values |>
    mutate(!!fc_name := (fx_raw - mean_r34) / sd_r34) |>
    select(Sub, all_of(fc_name))
  
    return(fx_final)
}

# Applying the FX function to all four ROIs 
fx_rFFA_rMMPFC <- calc_fx(child_TC, "rFFA", "rMMPFC", "Fx_rFFA_rMMPFC")
fx_rFFA_lMMPFC <- calc_fx(child_TC, "rFFA", "lMMPFC", "Fx_rFFA_lMMPFC")
fx_lFFA_rMMPFC <- calc_fx(child_TC, "lFFA", "rMMPFC", "Fx_lFFA_rMMPFC")
fx_lFFA_lMMPFC <- calc_fx(child_TC, "lFFA", "lMMPFC", "Fx_lFFA_lMMPFC")
```

```{r Long data}
# Reshape wide to long format for FX values for rFFA
long_data_rFFA <- wide_data |>
  select(Sub, Fm_rFFA, Fx_rFFA_rMMPFC, Fx_rFFA_lMMPFC,
         synchrony, GA, testing_age_days, mean_FD) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("Fx_rFFA"),
    names_to = "Connection",
    values_to = "Fx_rFFA_rlMMPFC"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Hemisphere = case_when(
      str_detect(Connection, "rMMPFC") ~ "Right",
      str_detect(Connection, "lMMPFC") ~ "Left"
    )
  )

# Reshape wide to long format for FX values for lFFA
long_data_lFFA <- wide_data |>
  select(Sub, Fm_lFFA, Fx_lFFA_rMMPFC, Fx_lFFA_lMMPFC,
         synchrony, GA, testing_age_days, mean_FD) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("Fx_lFFA"),
    names_to = "Connection",
    values_to = "Fx_lFFA_rlMMPFC"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Hemisphere = case_when(
      str_detect(Connection, "rMMPFC") ~ "Right",
      str_detect(Connection, "lMMPFC") ~ "Left"
    )
  )
```

```{r Model 5 & 6 : lm}
#for rFFA 
model5_rFFA <- lm(
  Fm_rFFA ~ Fx_rFFA_rMMPFC*synchrony + Fx_rFFA_lMMPFC*synchrony + GA + testing_age_days + mean_FD, 
  data = wide_data)
summary(model5_rFFA) #no predictors are significant - running it without interactions 

model6_rFFA <- lm(
  Fm_rFFA ~ Fx_rFFA_rMMPFC + Fx_rFFA_lMMPFC + synchrony + GA + testing_age_days + mean_FD, 
  data = wide_data)
summary(model6_rFFA) #no predictors are significant 

anova(model6_rFFA, model5_rFFA) #checking if dropping interaction is okay - yes! (no need to report)

#for lFFA 
model5_lFFA <- lm(
  Fm_lFFA ~ Fx_lFFA_rMMPFC*synchrony + Fx_lFFA_lMMPFC*synchrony+ GA + testing_age_days + mean_FD, 
  data = wide_data)
summary(model5_lFFA) #no predictors are significant (except for mean_FD) - running it without interactions 

model6_lFFA <- lm(
  Fm_lFFA ~ Fx_lFFA_rMMPFC + Fx_lFFA_lMMPFC + synchrony + GA + testing_age_days + mean_FD, 
  data = wide_data)
summary(model6_lFFA) #no predictors are significant (except for mean_FD)

anova(model6_lFFA, model5_lFFA) #checking if dropping interaction is okay - yes! (no need to report)


```

```{r Model Assumptions}

# Normality test
shapiro.test(residuals(model6_rFFA)) #both show non-normality (very mild)
shapiro.test(residuals(model6_lFFA))

# Homoscedasticity test
bptest(model6_rFFA) #rFFA has heteroscedasticity 
bptest(model6_lFFA)

# Linearity test (RESET)
resettest(model6_rFFA) #assumptions met 
resettest(model6_lFFA)

# Independence test
dwtest(model6_rFFA) #rFFA violate independence assumption (boderline) 
dwtest(model6_lFFA)

#plotting assumptions 
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(model6_rFFA)
plot(model6_lFFA)
#shows some non-linear trends

#checking for multicollinearity  
vif(model6_rFFA) #no multicollinearity
vif(model6_lFFA) 
```

```{r Model Visualization - raw data w/ mean - not included} 
#creating a function to make plots
plot_sync<- function(data, fx_var, fm_var, xlab, ylab) {
  ggplot(data, aes_string(x = fx_var, y = fm_var, color = "sync_group", fill = "sync_group")) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, alpha = 0.2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("#1f77b4", "#666666", "#d62728")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("-1 SD" = "#1f77b4", "Mean" = "#666666", "+1 SD" = "#d62728")) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = ylab, color = "Synchrony", fill = "Synchrony") +
    theme_minimal()
}

#plotting 
p1 <- plot_sync(plot_data, "Fx_rFFA_rMMPFC", "Fm_rFFA", "Fx rFFA–rMMPFC", "Fm rFFA")
p2 <- plot_sync(plot_data, "Fx_rFFA_lMMPFC", "Fm_rFFA", "Fx rFFA–lMMPFC", "Fm rFFA")
p3 <- plot_sync(plot_data, "Fx_lFFA_rMMPFC", "Fm_lFFA", "Fx lFFA–rMMPFC", "Fm lFFA")
p4 <- plot_sync(plot_data, "Fx_lFFA_lMMPFC", "Fm_lFFA", "Fx lFFA–lMMPFC", "Fm lFFA")

(p1 | p2) / (p3 | p4)
```

```{r Model visualization - raw data w/ quantiles}
#Creating quantile-based synchrony groups in a new df

#function to make tertile plot 
plot_sync_tertile <- function(data, fx_var, fm_var, xlab, ylab) {
  ggplot(data, aes_string(x = fx_var, y = fm_var, color = "sync_tertile", fill = "sync_tertile", linetype = "sync_tertile")) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, alpha = 0.2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Low" = "#1f77b4", "Medium" = "#666666", "High" = "#d62728")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Low" = "#1f77b4", "Medium" = "#666666", "High" = "#d62728")) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Low" = "dotted", "Medium" = "dashed", "High" = "solid")) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = ylab, color = "Synchrony", fill = "Synchrony", linetype = "Synchrony") +
    theme_minimal()
}

#plotting 
q1 <- plot_sync_tertile(plot_data, "Fx_rFFA_rMMPFC", "Fm_rFFA", "Fx rFFA–rMMPFC", "Fm rFFA")
q2 <- plot_sync_tertile(plot_data, "Fx_rFFA_lMMPFC", "Fm_rFFA", "Fx rFFA–lMMPFC", "Fm rFFA")
q3 <- plot_sync_tertile(plot_data, "Fx_lFFA_rMMPFC", "Fm_lFFA", "Fx lFFA–rMMPFC", "Fm lFFA")
q4 <- plot_sync_tertile(plot_data, "Fx_lFFA_lMMPFC", "Fm_lFFA", "Fx lFFA–lMMPFC", "Fm lFFA")
```

```{r Model visualization - w/ Beta co-eff}
#creating a function to extract significance 
stars <- function(p) {
  if (p < 0.001) return("***")
  else if (p < 0.01) return("**")
  else if (p < 0.05) return("*")
  else return("ns")
}
```

```{r Model visualization - prediction (not indluded)}

#synchrony levels and aesthetics
sync_stats <- wide_data |> 
  summarize(mean_sync = mean(synchrony, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_sync = sd(synchrony, na.rm = TRUE))

sync_levels <- c(sync_stats$mean_sync - sync_stats$sd_sync,
                 sync_stats$mean_sync,
                 sync_stats$mean_sync + sync_stats$sd_sync)

sync_labels <- c("-1 SD", "Mean", "+1 SD")
line_types <- c("dotted", "solid", "dashed")
colors <- c("blue","red", "grey")
names(colors) <- sync_labels
names(line_types) <- sync_labels

#creating a function 
make_plot_data <- function(model, focal_var, fixed_var, sync_levels, data) {
  focal_range <- seq(min(data[[focal_var]], na.rm = TRUE),
                     max(data[[focal_var]], na.rm = TRUE),
                     length.out = 100)
  
  fixed_mean <- mean(data[[fixed_var]], na.rm = TRUE)

  newdata <- expand.grid(
    synchrony = sync_levels,
    Fx_val = focal_range,
    GA = mean(data$GA, na.rm = TRUE),
    testing_age_days = mean(data$testing_age_days, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_FD = mean(data$mean_FD, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

  newdata[[focal_var]] <- newdata$Fx_val
  newdata[[fixed_var]] <- fixed_mean
  newdata$Fx_val <- NULL
  
  preds <- predict(model, newdata, interval = "confidence")
  newdata <- cbind(newdata, preds)
  newdata$sync_label <- factor(newdata$synchrony, levels = sync_levels, labels = sync_labels)
  
  return(newdata)
}

#rFFA plot data 
plot_data_rMMPFC <- make_plot_data(model5_rFFA, "Fx_rFFA_rMMPFC", "Fx_rFFA_lMMPFC", sync_levels, wide_data)
plot_data_lMMPFC <- make_plot_data(model5_rFFA, "Fx_rFFA_lMMPFC", "Fx_rFFA_rMMPFC", sync_levels, wide_data)

#Plotting function
plot_fx_interaction <- function(plot_data, xvar, xlab, ylab) {
  ggplot(plot_data, aes_string(x = xvar, y = "fit", 
                               color = "sync_label", fill = "sync_label", linetype = "sync_label")) +
    geom_line(size = 1.2) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lwr, ymax = upr), alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = line_types) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = ylab, color = "Synchrony", fill = "Synchrony", linetype = "Synchrony") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "right")
}

#plot rFFA 
p_rMMPFC <- plot_fx_interaction(plot_data_rMMPFC, "Fx_rFFA_rMMPFC", "fx rFFA–rMMPFC", "fm rFFA")
p_lMMPFC <- plot_fx_interaction(plot_data_lMMPFC, "Fx_rFFA_lMMPFC", "fx rFFA–lMMPFC", "fm rFFA")

# Print the plots
print(p_rMMPFC)
print(p_lMMPFC)

# plot for lFFA

#lFFA plot data 
plot_data_lFFA_rMMPFC <- make_plot_data(model5_lFFA, "Fx_lFFA_rMMPFC", "Fx_lFFA_lMMPFC", sync_levels, wide_data)
plot_data_lFFA_lMMPFC <- make_plot_data(model5_lFFA, "Fx_lFFA_lMMPFC", "Fx_lFFA_rMMPFC", sync_levels, wide_data)

# Generate and print the plots
p_lFFA_rMMPFC <- plot_fx_interaction(plot_data_lFFA_rMMPFC, "Fx_lFFA_rMMPFC", "fx lFFA–rMMPFC", "fm lFFA")
p_lFFA_lMMPFC <- plot_fx_interaction(plot_data_lFFA_lMMPFC, "Fx_lFFA_lMMPFC", "fx lFFA–lMMPFC", "fm lFFA")

print(p_lFFA_rMMPFC)
print(p_lFFA_lMMPFC)

(p_rMMPFC | p_lMMPFC) / (p_lFFA_rMMPFC | p_lFFA_lMMPFC)
```

```{r fMRI visualization child vs adult}

# Filter and average child TC
child_TC_filtered <- child_TC |> 
  filter(Sub %in% participant_data$Sub)

child_TC_avg <- child_TC_filtered |> 
  group_by(time) |>
  summarise(
    rFFA = mean(rFFA, na.rm = TRUE),
    lFFA = mean(lFFA, na.rm = TRUE),
    rMMPFC = mean(rMMPFC, na.rm = TRUE),
    lMMPFC = mean(lMMPFC, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |> 
  mutate(Group = "Child")

#Adult TC
adult_TC_avg <- adult_TC |> 
  select(time, rFFA, lFFA, rMMPFC, lMMPFC) |> 
  mutate(Group = "Adult")

#Combine adult and child 
combined_TC <- bind_rows(child_TC_avg, adult_TC_avg) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(time, Group), names_to = "ROI", values_to = "BOLD")

#for each TR
all_times <- expand.grid(
  time = 1:323,
  ROI = c("rFFA", "lFFA", "rMMPFC", "lMMPFC"),
  Group = c("Child", "Adult")
) |> 
  as_tibble()

combined_TC_full <- all_times |> 
  left_join(combined_TC, by = c("time", "ROI", "Group"))

#Plotting
ggplot(combined_TC_full, aes(x = time, y = BOLD, color = Group)) +
  geom_line(size = 0.5, na.rm = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ ROI, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    #title = "Child vs. Adult BOLD Signals Across ROIs",
    x = "Time (TR)",
    y = "Response Magnitude",
    color = "Group"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Child" = "#1f78b4", "Adult" = "#e31a1c")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5)
  )
```

```{r Master file}

#Combine fm and fx data
fm_fx_data <- fm_rFFA |>
  full_join(fm_lFFA, by = "Sub") |>
  full_join(fx_rFFA_rMMPFC, by = "Sub") |>
  full_join(fx_rFFA_lMMPFC, by = "Sub") |>
  full_join(fx_lFFA_rMMPFC, by = "Sub") |>
  full_join(fx_lFFA_lMMPFC, by = "Sub")

#Clean and rename keys to "Sub"
demographics_clean <- demographics |>
  rename(Sub = ID)

motion_clean <- motion |>
  filter(task == "pixar", run == "01") |>
  mutate(Sub = str_remove(subject, "sub-") |> as.numeric()) |>  # Extract numeric ID
  select(Sub, mean_FD = MeanFD)  # Rename to match rest of data

#Merge 
master_file <- fm_fx_data |>
  full_join(demographics_clean, by = "Sub") |>
  full_join(motion_clean, by = "Sub")

# Create subset without NAs in FM and FX
master_file_complete <- master_file |>
  filter(
    !is.na(Fm_rFFA),
    !is.na(Fm_lFFA),
    !is.na(Fx_rFFA_rMMPFC),
    !is.na(Fx_rFFA_lMMPFC),
    !is.na(Fx_lFFA_rMMPFC),
    !is.na(Fx_lFFA_lMMPFC)
  )

#scaling 
master_file_complete <- master_file_complete |> 
  mutate(
    GA = scale(GA)[, 1],
    testing_age_days = scale(testing_age_days)[, 1],
    mean_FD = scale(mean_FD)[, 1]
  )
```

```{r post-hoc -  model without sync}

#rFFA model without synchrony as predictor 
model7_rFFA <- lm(
  Fm_rFFA ~ Fx_rFFA_rMMPFC + Fx_rFFA_lMMPFC + GA + testing_age_days + mean_FD, 
  data = master_file_complete)
summary(model7_rFFA) #fx lmmpc is significant 

#lFFA model without synchrony as predictor 
model7_lFFA <- lm(
  Fm_lFFA ~ Fx_lFFA_rMMPFC + Fx_lFFA_lMMPFC + GA + testing_age_days + mean_FD, 
  data = master_file_complete)
summary(model7_lFFA) #testing_age & mean_FD are significant 

#note: variables are scaled 
```

```{r post hoc - splitting the mdoels} 

#rFFA model without synchrony as predictor 
#model 1 with rMMPFC
model8_rFFA1 <- lm(
  Fm_rFFA ~ Fx_rFFA_rMMPFC + GA + testing_age_days + mean_FD, 
  data = master_file_complete)
summary(model8_rFFA1) #nothing is significant 

#model 2 with lMMPFC
model8_rFFA2 <- lm(
  Fm_rFFA ~ Fx_rFFA_lMMPFC + GA + testing_age_days + mean_FD, 
  data = master_file_complete)
summary(model8_rFFA2) #nothing is significant (Fx is close .061)

#lFFA model without synchrony as predictor 
#model 1 with rMMPFC
model8_lFFA1 <- lm(
  Fm_lFFA ~ Fx_lFFA_rMMPFC + GA + testing_age_days + mean_FD, 
  data = master_file_complete)
summary(model8_lFFA1) #testing_age and mean_FD is significant 

#model 2 with lMMPFC
model8_lFFA2 <- lm(
  Fm_lFFA ~ Fx_lFFA_lMMPFC + GA + testing_age_days + mean_FD, 
  data = master_file_complete)
summary(model8_lFFA2) #mean_FD is significant (testing_age is close .061)
```

```{r post hoc analysis - model assumptions vif}

#checking for multicollinearity  
vif(model8_rFFA1) 
vif(model8_rFFA2) 
vif(model8_lFFA1)
vif(model8_lFFA2)
#everything is less than 1.07
```
